table.retrieve:
SELECT
	GroupCode=G.GroupCode,
	GroupName = G.GroupName,
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	impactinventory = dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	saletype = (Select Name From SaleType Where SaleTypeCode = dbo.SaleLedger.SaleTypeCode) ,
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
	invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	CustRefNo   = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	Patient     = dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	posted = dbo.saleledger.posted,	
	rowid = dbo.saledetail.rowid,
	looseqty = dbo.saledetail.looseqty, 
	bonusqty = dbo.saledetail.bonusqty, 
	machinename=saleledger.machinename,
	machineuser=(select users.username from users where users.usercode=saleledger.salesmancode),
	packing=case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) 	else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	packqty  = saledetail.packqty,  
	price = dbo.saledetail.saleprice,    
	itemdiscperc = dbo.saledetail.discperc,    
	packunits = dbo.saledetail.packunits,    
	batch = dbo.saledetail.batch,    
	expiry = dbo.saledetail.expiry,    
	salestax  = saledetail.salestax,
	itemname = item.name,
	itemalias=item.customicode,
	unitsalestax = dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax ,    
	gstperc = dbo.saledetail.gstperc ,    
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	customeralias=accounts.aliasname,
	cust_add1=(select customer.address1 from customer where customer.custcode=saleledger.custcode)
FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,    
	dbo.Item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (Item.packcode=itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.accounts,
	(SELECT GroupCode=M.ManfCode, GroupName=M.Name, I.ICode 
	FROM Manufacturer M, Item I 
	WHERE :as_group = 'M' AND I.ManfCode=M.ManfCode AND I.ManfCode = :ai_groupcode
	UNION 
	SELECT GroupCode=C.ICatCode, GroupName=C.Name, I.ICode 
	FROM ItemCategory C, Item I 
	WHERE :as_group = 'C' AND I.ICatCode=C.ICatCode AND I.ICatCode = :ai_groupcode
	UNION 
	SELECT GroupCode=L.ICCode, GroupName=L.Name, I.ICode 
	FROM ItemClass L, Item I 
	WHERE :as_group = 'L' AND I.ICCode=L.ICCode AND I.ICCode = :ai_groupcode
	UNION 
	SELECT GroupCode=P.PackCode, GroupName=P.Name, I.ICode 
	FROM ItemPacking P, Item I 
	WHERE :as_group = 'P' AND I.PackCode=P.PackCode AND I.PackCode = :ai_groupcode) G
	
WHERE  
	dbo.saleledger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate AND :ad_EndDate  AND
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:ai_saletype) AND 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (SELECT C.CustCode FROM Customer C WHERE C.AreaCode IN (:ai_areacode)) AND 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND
	dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode AND 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
	dbo.item.icode = G.Icode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	GroupCode=G.GroupCode,
	GroupName = G.GroupName,
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	impactinventory = dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	saletype = (Select Name From SaleType Where SaleTypeCode = dbo.SaleLedger.SaleTypeCode) ,
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
	invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	CustRefNo   = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	Patient     = dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	posted = dbo.saleledger.posted,	
	rowid = sd.rowid,
	looseqty = sd.looseqty, 
	bonusqty = sd.bonusqty, 
	machinename=saleledger.machinename,
	machineuser=(select users.username from users where users.usercode=saleledger.salesmancode),
	packing=case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	itemflatdisc=sd.itemflatdisc,
	packqty  = 0,  
	price = sd.saleprice,    
	itemdiscperc = sd.discperc,    
	packunits = sd.packunits,    
	batch = sd.batch,    
	expiry = sd.expiry,    
	salestax  = 0,
	itemname = item.name,
	itemalias=item.customicode,
	unitsalestax = sd.unitsalestax ,    
	gstperc = sd.gstperc ,    
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	customeralias=accounts.aliasname,
	cust_add1=(select customer.address1 from customer where customer.custcode=saleledger.custcode)
FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saleinvdetail sd,    
	dbo.Item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (Item.packcode=itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.accounts,
	(SELECT GroupCode=M.ManfCode, GroupName=M.Name, I.ICode 
	FROM Manufacturer M, Item I 
	WHERE :as_group = 'M' AND I.ManfCode=M.ManfCode AND I.ManfCode = :ai_groupcode
	UNION 
	SELECT GroupCode=C.ICatCode, GroupName=C.Name, I.ICode 
	FROM ItemCategory C, Item I 
	WHERE :as_group = 'C' AND I.ICatCode=C.ICatCode AND I.ICatCode = :ai_groupcode
	UNION 
	SELECT GroupCode=L.ICCode, GroupName=L.Name, I.ICode 
	FROM ItemClass L, Item I 
	WHERE :as_group = 'L' AND I.ICCode=L.ICCode AND I.ICCode = :ai_groupcode
	UNION 
	SELECT GroupCode=P.PackCode, GroupName=P.Name, I.ICode 
	FROM ItemPacking P, Item I 
	WHERE :as_group = 'P' AND I.PackCode=P.PackCode AND I.PackCode = :ai_groupcode) G
	
WHERE  
	dbo.saleledger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:ai_saletype) and
	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (SELECT C.CustCode FROM Customer C WHERE C.AreaCode IN (:ai_areacode)) AND 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
	sd.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
	dbo.item.icode = G.Icode

Order By 
	GroupName, saleinvcode, date, rowid

objects.name: c_itemdiscount
objects.visible: 1	if(Round(( looseqty * price - itemflatdisc) *  ( itemdiscperc *  .01 ) ,2) + itemflatdisc + Round(( looseqty * price  -  itemflatdisc ) * (1 - itemdiscperc *  .01 ) * ( invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) =0, 0, 1)
objects.expression: Round(( looseqty * price - itemflatdisc) *  ( itemdiscperc *  .01 ) ,2) + itemflatdisc + Round(( looseqty * price  -  itemflatdisc ) * (1 - itemdiscperc *  .01 ) * ( invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2)

objects.name: c_itemsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( (  (looseqty + bonusqty) *  unitsalestax ) + Round ( c_amount *  gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) ,  2 )

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round(((  looseqty   *  price  )-(itemflatdisc* looseqty))  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ), 2)

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: sum(Round(( looseqty * price - itemflatdisc) *  ( itemdiscperc *  .01 ) ,2) + itemflatdisc + Round(( looseqty * price  -  itemflatdisc ) * (1 - itemdiscperc *  .01 ) * ( invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2)  for group 1)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum(Round ( (  (looseqty + bonusqty) *  unitsalestax ) + Round ( c_amount *  gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) ,  2 ) for group 1)

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: sum(Round(((  looseqty   *  price  )-(itemflatdisc* looseqty))  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ), 2) for group 1)
